name: HPP Food Services - Wilmington
old_description: HPP Food Services helps natural food and beverage companies high pressure process without compromise.
about:
HPP Food Services operates from Wilmington, California. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not disclosed in public sources.

The company provides high pressure processing (HPP) services for natural food and beverage brands. Its operations team works alongside Avure scientists to offer formulation support, packaging consultation, lab testing coordination, and HACCP plan integration. The facility processes a wide range of products including juices, smoothies, guacamole, salsas, meats, ready-to-eat meals, meal trays, spouted pouches, wet salads, dressings, dips, soups, hummus, snack packs, dairy spreads, sauces, purees, baby food, and pet food.

HPP Food Services serves natural food and beverage companies across categories such as beverages, prepared meals, dips and spreads, dairy, sauces, baby food, and pet food. Customers include brands seeking extended shelf life without preservatives, and the company emphasizes a partnership approach to help clients navigate formulation and regulatory requirements.

The company states its mission is to help clients high pressure process without compromise, offering a trusting partnership, a resilient and flexible operating environment, and access to Avure scientific expertise to overcome formulation challenges.
